description: Fathom is an AI meeting recorder; its API exposes meetings, transcripts, summaries and action items.
auth_notes: Personal API keys sent in an X-Api-Key header; OAuth apps are supported for integrations other Fathom users install.
gate_detail: Key is generated in API Access of User Settings; docs say anyone can start building. Which plan is required is not stated. Keys see only the user's own or team-shared meetings. 60 calls per minute limit.
api_scope: Meetings list with filters and pagination, transcripts, summaries and action items; separate recording transcript endpoint; TypeScript and Python SDKs.
mcp_notes: Docs describe an official Fathom MCP server for connecting meeting data to LLMs; URL not stated in sources.
blocker_detail: No approval or payment gate stated for API keys; OAuth marketplace listing is partner-only but optional.
